items.title: Gucci Sets Up New Business Units' Organization
items.summary: Gucci restructured into separate business units (leather goods, women's RTW, men's RTW, shoes) with distinct calendars and decision processes to support Demna's creative direction. Industry veterans Monica Ulmi and Marco Semeghini (both ex-Gucci, 1990s-2000s merchandising background) rejoin as senior advisers based between Milan and Florence, working alongside Demna and CEO Francesca Bellettini. Neutral factual organizational reporting, trade-press corroborated.

items.title: Kering crolla a Parigi: pesa la frenata di Gucci, il titolo perde fino al 12%
items.summary: Kering shares fell as much as 12.3% in Paris after Q3 2026 results; group revenue of EUR3.345bn roughly met expectations but Gucci (about 39% of group revenue) posted a 6% comparable sales decline, directly-operated stores down 9%, with a particularly steep 14% APAC/China contraction. Article frames Gucci's turnaround as 'determinante' for the whole group and adopts a skeptical tone about management's recovery plan despite citing improved average ticket and conversion. Negative earnings/momentum framing.

items.title: Gucci unveils a new side of itself on Avenue Montaigne
items.summary: Report on the new Avenue Montaigne flagship (56 Avenue Montaigne, four floors, ~1,480sqm, no visible price tags), positioning it as the template for Gucci's broader store-concept rollout under Demna and CEO Francesca Bellettini. Largely descriptive retail/activation coverage of a brand-staged opening; no independent critical verdict offered.

items.title: Gucci Closes 25 Stores, Opens a Bigger Paris Flagship
items.summary: Analysis piece noting Gucci closed 25 net stores in 2026 (11 North America, 6 Western Europe, 5 APAC) while opening the larger Avenue Montaigne flagship, part of a plan to cut store count ~30% by 2030 while shrinking total square metres only ~25%. Frames the strategy as 'fewer, bigger, appointment-led' retail, implicitly acknowledging a shrinking physical footprint amid the turnaround. Mixed-to-neutral trade framing; tag negative_earnings for footprint contraction context.

items.title: Fans Are 'Disappointed' Over Mariah Carey's 'Depressing' Gucci Holiday Campaign & 'Boring' Styling
items.summary: Report compiling fan and TikTok reaction to Gucci's 2026 holiday campaign ('Gucci Gift') starring Mariah Carey, directed by Harmony Korine. Viewers called the ad 'depressing,' 'outdated,' 'sterile' and lacking holiday warmth; one TikTok comment compared it to 'if JCPenney was trying to be luxury.' Organic negative consumer reaction to a brand activation (backlash against activation is not subject to the activation discount per rubric) — magnitude 1.0 eligible as independent public reaction.

items.title: Forum Members Review the 'Vulgar' Gucci Spring 2027 Collection From Demna
items.summary: Aggregated fashion-forum member reactions (via forums.thefashionspot.com) to Demna's Spring 2027 Gucci show staged in Times Square; headline itself uses forum members' 'vulgar' characterization, split between those calling it a cynical shock tactic and others defending it as provocative brand repositioning. Older item (outside 14-day window) retained only as background context for today's ongoing Demna-era discourse threads below; not counted toward freshness-weighted volume.

items.title: 2026 Gucci Flora - PurseForum thread
items.summary: Active PurseForum thread where members discuss and share photos of 2026 Gucci Flora pieces (totes, bucket bags) in new colorways; largely product-appreciation/purchase-consideration chatter typical of community fandom volume, mild positive purchase-intent sentiment, magnitude damped per fandom-trap guidance.

items.title: Gucci's quality issue / quality concerns thread
items.summary: Long-running PurseForum thread (recently active) where members compare notes on perceived declining construction quality, chipped hardware and finishing versus rising prices; recurring QC-complaint and value-for-money sentiment consistent with negative rubric category. Legitimate community opinion, not promotional.

items.title: Talk me out of buying a Gucci handbag please
items.summary: Mumsnet community thread where UK posters debate whether a Gucci handbag is worth the price versus alternatives; replies raise value-for-money skepticism and some quality/durability doubts alongside posters defending the purchase. Mixed-but-decided toward caution; genuine consumer discourse, EU priority-A community source.

items.title: Jake Woolf on X: Gucci horse-bit loafers by Demna
items.summary: Menswear editor/influencer post praising newly released Demna-designed Gucci horse-bit loafers ('ultra soft leather... will sell like hot cakes'); independent third-party positive product judgment, not brand-owned, eligible for standard positive weight though from a single niche creator account.

items.title: gucci on X: GENERATION GUCCI / GucciCore campaign post
items.summary: Official Gucci brand account post promoting the GucciCore/Generation Gucci campaign (foundational wardrobe pieces shot by Peter Funch on New York streets). Brand-owned promotional copy = neutral (0) per rubric; retained for buzz/volume tracking only, tagged activation_coverage.

items.title: Gucci's New Paris Flagship Debuts a Whole New Store Concept
items.summary: Lifestyle-press walkthrough of the Avenue Montaigne flagship interior (Appartamento salon, stone/wood/lacquer room differentiation); descriptive activation coverage of the brand-staged store opening with no independent evaluative verdict. Tag activation_coverage.

items.title: Gucci takes GucciCore campaign to New York streets
items.summary: Trade-press write-up of the GucciCore campaign's continued rollout; purely descriptive marketing-trade coverage of what the campaign is and who shot it (Peter Funch), no independent judgment offered. Tag activation_coverage, sentiment 0.

items.title: Kering perde oltre l'11% in Borsa dopo i conti deludenti di Gucci e trascina al ribasso il settore del lusso europeo
items.summary: Italian financial press report on Kering's >11% share drop following disappointing Gucci Q3 results, noting the slump dragged down the broader European luxury sector (Moncler, Cucinelli also fell). Clear negative earnings/momentum framing of Gucci as the proximate cause.

items.title: Gucci Memoria: una mostra curata da Demna
items.summary: Review of the Gucci Memoria exhibition (Milan Design Week/Fuorisalone) curated by Demna, tracing the house's 105-year history via tapestries and installations; praised as thoughtful and craft-rooted rather than spectacle. Independent critical praise but dated well outside the freshness window — retained only as background context, excluded from volume/freshness scoring.
